comment: Pinned SPICE kernel set, loaded in this order by spiceInterface.addKernelPaths. The ID is the file stem and is immutable: changing any file needs a new ID. The service verifies each file's SHA-256 in kernels/ before loading and never downloads during ConfigureRun. NAIF moves superseded files into a_old_versions/, so each entry lists fallback URLs. Entries are copied unchanged from origin/spice-integration:Argus.Spice/kernels.json.

coverage_utc.source: Earth binary PCK file name; confirm with pckcov when the loader is built

kernels.purpose: Leap seconds for UTC <-> ephemeris time (TDB).
JPL DE440 planetary ephemeris (short span, 1849-2150): Sun and Earth positions.
High-precision Earth orientation (ITRF93): reconstructed 2000-01-01 to 2026-09-25, predicted to 2026-12-22.
Body constants (Earth and Sun radii, used by the eclipse model).
